connections.why: The principles of nutrition are applied to keep people healthy
Applying nutrition guides cooking a genuinely healthy, varied diet
A repertoire of savoury dishes is the basis of a varied diet
Nutritional knowledge shapes which dishes are worth cooking
Ingredients are prepared before heat is applied to cook them
Preparing ingredients relies on the right utensils and equipment
How food is cooked affects how it is seasoned and combined
Competent cooking technique is what makes a dish possible to cook
Where food comes from is tied to when it is in season
Seasonal produce has the best characteristics for cooking
Knowing an ingredient's characteristics guides how to prepare it
Taste and texture of ingredients inform seasoning and combinations
Knowing ingredient sources supports planning a varied diet
